as_told.title: L'Espresso article on Trump taking control of special access programs

plain: In the summer of 2025, the Italian magazine L'Espresso published an article that, according to Jesse Michels, drew on a confidential source and claimed that President Donald Trump was taking control of special access programs, the Pentagon's most tightly restricted secret projects, away from the Pentagon. Michels tells it himself in two episodes. In one he dates the article to July 2025 and says it discusses something called Project Preserve Destiny. In the other he leaves that name out and dwells on the struggle over the secret programs, which would matter because it would put the White House in charge of whatever those programs hold.
